claim: 'All 11 benign variants in this set entered the benchmark as curated no-lesion controls'
finding: FALSE since v8.0. MLH1 H718Y is clinically benign and carries a committed monomer-fold destabilization.
fix: Corrected to 'Ten of the 11', and the exception is now stated as the paper's own thesis: structurally destabilized and clinically neutral at once.
why_it_was_missed: A stale CONCLUSION, not a stale number — '11' was still correct, so a number sweep could not see it.

claim: Assembled-fold basis read 'token inferred from the intact monomer fold'
finding: The same v8.0 change committed that monomer axis as destabilizing, falsifying the premise. Shared with 10 other axes, for which it remains true.
fix: H718Y given its own basis: inferred from proficient MMR and a surviving interaction, not from the isolated fold. New cross-axis check in verify_ledger_token_basis gates the class; control fires.
why_it_was_missed: The per-axis check reads each row alone, so a basis whose premise a sibling correction falsified still passed.

claim: 'Complete recovery here rests on 13 positives … recovers all 17 positives on the whole subset'
finding: Both halves false. The restriction recovers 13 of 16; the full-tier screen recovers 17 of 21, sensitivity 0.810.
fix: Rewritten with both fractions and the sensitivity stated.
why_it_was_missed: Perfect-value leftovers from when tier-screen sensitivity was 1.000.

claim: Nine alternative formulas and 13 leave-one-system-out folds
finding: Values correct and reproduce exactly, but no generator in the repository recomputed them — they survived only as saved tables.
fix: build_priority_sensitivity_summary.py reads the nine scores from the committed per-variant columns rather than reimplementing them, asserts both claim shapes, and is wired into CI.
why_it_was_missed: Published numbers nothing recomputes are how this repository has acquired stale values before.
